storage_pvc_used_bytes.query: max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{namespace="demo-app",persistentvolumeclaim=~"data-storage-probe-.*"}) or max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (storage_probe_fill_bytes{namespace="demo-app",persistentvolumeclaim=~"data-storage-probe-.*"})

storage_pvc_available_bytes.query: max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes{namespace="demo-app",persistentvolumeclaim=~"data-storage-probe-.*"}) or max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (clamp_min(storage_probe_requested_capacity_bytes{namespace="demo-app",persistentvolumeclaim=~"data-storage-probe-.*"} - storage_probe_fill_bytes{namespace="demo-app",persistentvolumeclaim=~"data-storage-probe-.*"}, 0))

storage_pvc_usage_ratio.query: max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{namespace="demo-app",persistentvolumeclaim=~"data-storage-probe-.*"} / clamp_min(kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{namespace="demo-app",persistentvolumeclaim=~"data-storage-probe-.*"}, 1)) or max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (storage_probe_usage_ratio{namespace="demo-app",persistentvolumeclaim=~"data-storage-probe-.*"})
